svg.title: byobu-keyhints demo
svg.desc: The status-bar hint changes as panes are split, the prefix key is pressed, a pane is zoomed, copy mode is entered and typing into all panes is turned on.

g.text: Ctrl+F2:Split left/right Shift+F2:Split top/bottom F2:New window
Shift+Arrows:Move Ctrl+a then Ctrl+Arrows:Resize Shift+F11:Zoom Ctrl+F6:Close
Shift+Arrows:Move Ctrl+a then Ctrl+Arrows:Resize Shift+F11:Zoom Ctrl+F6:Close
Shift+Arrows:Move Ctrl+a then Ctrl+Arrows:Resize Shift+F11:Zoom Ctrl+F6:Close
[Copy mode] Arrows/PgUp:Scroll Space:Select v:Rectangle Enter:Copy /:Search q:Quit (paste: Ctrl+a ])
Shift+Arrows:Move Ctrl+a then Ctrl+Arrows:Resize Shift+F11:Zoom Ctrl+F6:Close
WARNING: typing goes to ALL panes Alt+F9:Turn off
Alt+F9 type into ALL panes (easy to hit by accident)
Shift+Arrows:Move Ctrl+a then Ctrl+Arrows:Resize Shift+F11:Zoom Ctrl+F6:Close
